title: Articles in Biology: a, an, the and zero article
objective: Students fix article problems common in Thai-English biology writing.
outcomes: Use a/an for one nonspecific item.
Use the when the reader knows the item.
Use zero article for general plural or uncountable nouns.
Apply article choices to biology nouns.
activity: Article sort: students place biology nouns into a/an, the, or no article columns.
example: General: “Cells contain DNA.” Specific: “The cells in the treatment group grew faster.”
